nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.text: The salon is a carefully engineered accident of proximity: policy, money, and people who can afford to look bored. Maris Quell stands near a tall window, glass half-full, expression half-elsewhere.

choices.text: Approach Maris before your faculties form a committee.
The woman beside her is already measuring you. Address that.

faculty_interjections.text: Window exit, two conversational clusters, one dead zone by the ferns. Ferns are always guilty.
She has seen you. Or she is looking at the window. Or both. Both is worse.

nodes.speaker: taly_renn
nodes.text: Before you invent a weather opener: I'm Taly Renn. She's Maris. You're hovering like a man who has been briefed on hovering. Spit out a name and we'll decide if you're interesting.

choices.text: Cassian Orth. Trade liaison. I hover professionally.
Cassian. I'm worse at first sentences than at freight.

faculty_interjections.text: She clocked the briefing. Do not confirm it with posture.
Lean into the hover. Own the hover. Become the hover.

nodes.speaker: maris_quell
nodes.text: Cassian Orth. Ministry Trade. I've read two of your memoranda — the short ones. You write like someone who is afraid of adjectives.

choices.text: Adjectives inflate risk. I prefer verbs that ship.
That... might be the kindest autopsy I've ever received.
How is Observatory Circle funding looking this quarter?

faculty_interjections.text: She read your memos. She knows you are allergic to beauty.
That was almost a compliment. Reciprocate without a spreadsheet.
Funding question is on-script. Also obvious. Calibrate.
She led with your work, not your cover charm. Meet her there as a person.

nodes.speaker: maris_quell
nodes.text: Verbs that ship. You sound like a briefing note that learned to stand upright. Taly, he's house-trained.

faculty_interjections.text: She noticed the protocol. Soften or she'll file you under 'handled.'

nodes.speaker: maris_quell
nodes.text: Good. Most people try to un-autopsy themselves in the next sentence. You left the body on the table. Refreshing — or suspicious. I'm collecting data.

effects.summary: Maris called your self-awareness refreshing or suspicious.

choices.text: Collect away. I'll try not to contaminate the sample.

faculty_interjections.text: She's running her own assessment. You are not the only spy in the metaphor.

nodes.speaker: taly_renn
nodes.text: He went straight to funding. Maris, your admirers are getting efficient.

faculty_interjections.text: Too fast. You smelled like an agenda.

nodes.speaker: maris_quell
nodes.text: Funding is looking like a conversation for people who have already survived small talk. We haven't. Try again without the briefcase.

choices.text: Fair. What's the least boring thing in this room that isn't politics?

faculty_interjections.text: She asked for a person. Supply one.
